name: Maverick Parker
source:
Maverick is one of Lucifer's top performing Lusts from the state of Texas. Everything's bigger in Texas, and he's come to Las Vegas to help out Kosuke with anything he needs. Lucifer's orders. Loves to work out. Loves his job as Lust. Those two things are his primary focuses. Anything, or anyone, that gets in the way, is expendable. Maverick has a lot of self defense mechanisms built up over the years... But he has a softer side that can emerge. In the right conditions.

[From Kickstarter]
